summary.text: Cathryn Harvey is a Democratic state representative from Cheshire District 6 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia, which lists her as Cathryn A. Harvey, says her career includes working as a music teacher.

paragraphs.text: Cathryn Harvey's career experience includes working as a music teacher.
She founded the Chesterfield Public School Foundation and has served as chair of the Chesterfield Library Board of Trustees, as a guardian ad litem and as a member of the International Lions Club.
Ballotpedia gives Harvey's tenure in the New Hampshire House of Representatives as beginning in 2016, with her current service dated from December 7, 2022.
She was assigned to the Fish and Game and Marine Resources Committee in 2021-2022 and 2023-2024, and chaired it in 2019-2020.
Harvey advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 ballot for Cheshire 6, a two-seat district.
